strategies.text:
Estimated Time to Win: [277.5s - 295s]

Battle Party Breakdown:

Mega Gengar [Executor] 1x: Used early to get the boss aggressive. Immediately switched out once Azelf casts a charge move. Towards the end of the fight, Mega Gengar can optionally be swapped back in to deal a knock out blow with shadow ball. This is generally if you're unable to build toward Moongeist Beam

Necrozma Dawn Wings [Main/Support DPS] 3-5x: Cast 2-3 Moongeist Beams each depending on how aggressive Azelf is using Future Sight. Necrozma can comfortably tank 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts. Once the active Necrozma Dawn Wings is unable to build another Moongeist Beam, switch to the next healthy one. Future sight & Fire blast damage vary with weather.

DPS Tips:

Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]: While not required, it is extremely helpful to time each Moongeist beam, especially if running the high energy focused Psycho Cut. A detailed breakdown of TPC can be found in the raid mechanics webpage. In order to TPC, simply slow down your taps as energy nears 100. Wait a brief moment after the 2nd to last tap and then cast Moongeist Beam. If this strategy isn't preferred, Shadow Claw may be the better option. Time Save: ~10-15s

Substitute [Sub]: Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps overcome this issue. Time Save: Varies
